pages.name: Grave Hag
pages.text: A burial-ground necrophage miniboss: 120 base HP, 9 claw damage. Its wasted body wears a ragged shroud and bone ornaments.

One Grave Hag guards each rare burial ground: an abandoned village graveyard on open land, a forgotten forest graveyard, or an ancient necropolis. Explore new lands. A slain guardian never respawns. Spirit Ward does not prevent this encounter. There is no global natural spawn.
Claws: a 12-tick windup, then one strike. Tongue: a locked straight shot up to6 blocks, followed by a short physical pull. Dodge sideways or use cover; it cannot pass through walls.

Curse: Weakness4 seconds and Slowness3 seconds, up to8 blocks with line of sight. One lifetime wave of at most two fragile ghosts; they expire within20 seconds or when combat ends. Spirit Ward does not block this special summon.

Use necrophage oil, interrupt with existing stun tools, dodge the tongue and punish recovery. Guaranteed tongue and remains; graveyard essence75%. All three are materials reserved for future Stage19 recipes.
